summary: This pass expands the public-market universe around state/local modernization, identity verification, cyber-compliance, emergency communications, and public-safety systems. Pure-play U.S. election-equipment exposure appears limited because many core voting-system vendors are private or sponsor-owned; therefore the investable universe shifts toward adjacent public-sector software, TSA/government identity enrollment, NG911 infrastructure, and law-enforcement/public-safety analytics. The underfollowed lane is strongest in Telos, Comtech, and SoundThinking, but two are sub-USD-300M speculative exceptions that require procurement and balance-sheet verification before surviving later layers.
